definitions.explanation: The punctuation marks { } used primarily in mathematics and programming. Called 中括弧 (middle brackets) because they fall between parentheses (small) and square brackets (large) in the Japanese bracket hierarchy.

examples.japanese: {中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コード→コード：00241_koodo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Write the code inside curly brackets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: In mathematics, sets are represented with curly brackets.

examples.japanese: {中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じ→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you forget to close the curly bracket, you'll get an error.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ (middle) + ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ (brackets). In the traditional Japanese bracket naming convention, the three main types form a size hierarchy: {小括弧|しょうかっこ} (parentheses) < {中括弧|ちゅうかっこ} (curly brackets) < {大括弧|だいかっこ} (square brackets). However, in modern usage, ⟦{丸括弧|まるかっこ}→丸括弧：26049_marukakko⟧/⟦{角括弧|かくかっこ}→角括弧：26050_kakukakko⟧/{中括弧|なかかっこ} (named by shape) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose in curly brackets
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a curly bracket
- {中括弧|なかかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close a curly bracket

NAMING NOTE:
Also called {波括弧|なみかっこ} (wave brackets) due to their curved shape. In programming contexts, the English loanword ブレース (brace) is sometimes used.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丸括弧|まるかっこ}→丸括弧：26049_marukakko⟧: parentheses ( ) -- the most common bracket type
- ⟦{角括弧|かくかっこ}→角括弧：26050_kakukakko⟧: square brackets [ ] -- used in academic and technical writing
